title: A LazyFrame read twice in one query is evaluated per reference
verdict: a subplan joined with itself is computed twice, in memory and streaming
description: A LazyFrame with a column pl.int_range(0, 1000).shuffle() joined with itself on its key gives rows whose two reads differ (999, 1000 and 999 of 1000 rows in memory; 998, 1000, 999 streaming; 1000 with comm_subplan_elim off). Common subplan elimination does not make the two reads one evaluation here.

So a check root and a sink root over one LazyFrame may read two evaluations of a double SUM in it, in two orders (polars-sum-float, polars-sum-float-streaming): within the plan's bound of each other's reference, so a check needs a margin of 2ε, as #929's does.
reference: The reference evaluates a shared subplan once (Rel.eval).
